key.name: glass-brightness
key.description: Brightness of the dark glass. 0 is dark smoked glass; 100 shows the desktop through clear dark glass. Higher values mean less darkening, not more white paint.

key.name: glass-light-brightness
key.description: Brightness of the light glass. 0 is dense pale glass; 100 lets more of the desktop through.

key.name: glass-mode
key.description: Auto follows the system color scheme. Light and Dark force that glass, and Clear is a near-transparent veil with clean light text.

key.name: glass-style
key.description: Liquid bends the backdrop at the rim, Crystal sharpens that bend into a thin bright edge, Glow drops the bend for a soft halo, and Flat uses a simple tint with no blur.

key.name: animations
key.description: Whether Sift fades and scales in and out.

key.name: app-order
key.description: How the app grid sorts applications: A-Z, recent use, most used, or a smart blend of frequency and recency.

key.name: max-results
key.description: Largest number of result rows kept for the search view; extras scroll.

key.name: web-search
key.description: Show a last, low-priority row that searches the web or opens a typed address in the default browser. It only appears when local results leave room, and Sift never contacts the network by itself. Off by default.

key.name: web-search-engine
key.description: Search engine used by the web row. Opening a typed address uses the default browser directly.

key.name: web-browser
key.description: Desktop ID of the browser that opens web rows. Empty uses the system default for https.

key.name: settings-search
key.description: Include GNOME Settings panels in search results. Off by default; turn on to find panels such as Displays and Wi-Fi.

key.name: fullscreen-guard
key.description: Ignore Sift shortcuts while an application is fullscreen. Turn off to open Sift over fullscreen apps.

key.name: search-height
key.description: Height in logical pixels (it scales with the display) of the expanded search panel; clamped to fit the monitor.

key.name: grid-labels
key.description: Whether app names appear under icons in the app grid.

key.name: disable-overview
key.description: When on, Super and Super+A open Sift and every other GNOME overview trigger (Activities, the hot corner, swipe and the login overview) does nothing. When off, GNOME's overview works normally.

key.name: update-check
key.description: Check GitHub once a day for a new Sift release and show a notification. Only the release check is sent; no usage data leaves the machine.

key.name: sift-search-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Sift search. When unset with the GNOME overview disabled, Super is the default; a recorded shortcut replaces it. Sift never changes GNOME's own shortcuts.

key.name: sift-apps-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Sift's app grid. When unset with the GNOME overview disabled, Super+A is the default; a recorded shortcut replaces it. Sift never changes GNOME's own shortcuts.

key.name: sift-workspaces-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens Sift's workspace and window switcher. When unset with the GNOME overview disabled, Super+Tab is the default and replaces the app switcher while Sift fills that role; a recorded shortcut replaces it. With the overview enabled the default is Ctrl+Super+Tab. Sift never changes GNOME's own shortcuts.
